entities.summary: Christine Nkulikiyinka is Rwandan politician, diplomat and CEP. She is a member of cabinet of Rwanda, where she serves as the Minister of Public Service and Labor since her appointment on 16 August 2024. She was also Rwanda's ambassador to several countries including Germany, Sweden and Russia. In 2022 she became the CEO of Rwanda Cooperation.
